headline: $25,000 toward a first home.
subhead: Connecticut's Time To Own: 0% interest, no monthly payment, forgivable. Swipe.

slides.title: What it is
slides.text: A forgivable second loan for your down payment and closing costs, run by CHFA. 0% interest and no monthly payment.

slides.title: How much you can get
slides.text: Household income at or below 80% of area median: up to $25,000. Between 80% and 100%: up to $18,750.

slides.title: Income limits here
slides.text: Western CT region, which covers Danbury, Bethel, Newtown, Brookfield, Ridgefield, Wilton and New Milford.

slides.title: The fine print
slides.text: It only works with a CHFA first mortgage from a participating lender. Minimum is $3,000, and state funding is limited.

slides.title: Your next step
slides.text: Ask a CHFA-participating lender to pre-approve you for both before you start making offers.

cta_text: Comment GRANT and I'll send my Time To Own checklist.
caption:
Up to $25,000 toward your first home, at 0% with no monthly payment.

Connecticut's Time To Own program is a forgivable second loan for down payment and closing costs, run by CHFA. If your household income is at or below 80% of area median, you can get up to $25,000. Between 80% and 100%, up to $18,750.

For Danbury and the rest of the Western CT region, CHFA's current limits (June 2026) are $156,800 for 100% of median and $125,440 for 80%.

The fine print: it only pairs with a CHFA first mortgage from a participating lender, the minimum is $3,000, and state funding is limited. Get pre-approved for both before you make offers.

Comment GRANT and I'll send my Time To Own checklist.
